states.name: Account
states.ax:
- main:
  - status:
    - list
  - 'heading "Editing: Friedrich Wilhelm von Braunenberg" [level=1]'
  - button "Toggle breadcrumbs"
  - navigation "Breadcrumb":
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - link "Friedrich Wilhelm von Braunenberg":
          - /url: ""
  - navigation "Actions":
    - button "Actions"
  - button "Toggle status"
  - link "History":
    - /url: /admin/users/history/7/
  - complementary "Minimap"
  - heading "Friedrich Wilhelm von Braunenberg" [level=2]
  - tablist:
    - tab "Account" [selected]
    - tab "Roles"
  - tabpanel "Account":
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: Username* Required. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.
        - textbox "Username*": german
      - listitem:
        - text: Email*
        - textbox "Email*": german@example.com
      - listitem:
        - text: First Name*
        - textbox "First Name*": Friedrich Wilhelm
      - listitem:
        - text: Last Name*
        - textbox "Last Name*": von Braunenberg
      - listitem:
        - text: Password Leave blank if not changing.
        - textbox "Password"
      - listitem:
        - text: Password confirmation Enter the same password as above, for verification.
        - textbox "Password confirmation"
      - listitem:
        - text: Active Designates whether this user should be treated as active. Unselect this instead of deleting accounts.
        - checkbox "Active" [checked]
  - navigation "Actions (footer)":
    - button "Save":
      - emphasis: Save
